name: Reported vehicle restoration open and selected-item capture — NOT RUN

steps._note: Disposable CodexTest with a real repairable V8 Truck/4x4 under native radial interaction, menus closed and a known visible item in unlocked backpack editorSlot0. Parent first performs the actual radial Restore Vehicle action and records the vehicle entity/assembly ID, log sequence, and first-open profiler interval. The bridge has no fixture-independent radial selector in this scenario, so window-open is a required precondition rather than fabricated by ui open. Review screenshot at 5120x1440 and 2736x1440 for no X, readable statistics, square art, slot colors/scrollbar, eight modifier slots, cosmetics, action icon/vertical alignment, selected-item preview and opaque uniform panes. Repeat open/close under profiler for freeze regression.
